title: Urban resilience through risk-informed planning
discussion_signal: The post connects liveability and resilience to natural systems, residents, the built environment, and local and global economies. It frames risk-informed planning as a way to protect communities and make urban investment serve safety and inclusion rather than treating resilience as a standalone engineering goal.
linked_research_question: How do urban planning, infrastructure, ecology, and social equity combine to produce liveable and resilient places?
